records.geometryMethod: Pinned 2026-09-05 OSM الرميلية polygon minus the native ISIE أولاد الفالح candidate, computed in EPSG:32632 and transformed to WGS84; mixed-source derived geometry.
records.uncertainty: This is a derived split of an old OSM polygon, not the native ISIE الرميلية outline. It differs from that outline by about 3.19 km²; nine components include small registration fragments. It avoids material new overlaps with unchanged app neighbors but is not surveyed accuracy.

review.geometryPolicy: Candidate geometry is used exactly as staged or as the stated set difference; no clipping, buffering, snapping, repair or simplification. App 1e-6 quantization is validated and component/hole loss fails staging.
review.identityRegistry: INS official sector codes and code-matched governorate/delegation parents; identity evidence remains subject to human review.
review.acceptance: Staged best-effort imada candidate only; this record does not assert decree-reviewed whole-imada geometry.
review.repair: No automatic geometry repair or topology cleanup. Any derived set operation is recorded per record.
review.uncertainty: These provisional footprints do not certify whole-imada coverage or present-day boundary accuracy. Review the per-record source interpretation and all reported overlaps; runtime conflict handling excludes overlapping sector claims only at their intersections, and gaps are not filled.
